ABOUT ME

me

Hello there, I'm Army 👋

I'm a Southern Utah Based photographer with a passion for capturing candid moments. I specialize in creating images that capture just how you felt on that special day. It is my goal to give you images that you will love forever.

When I'm not behind the camera, you can find me longboarding with my friends or hiking out in our beautiful state. I believe that every moment is an opportunity to experience something new and to create lifelong memories.

Thank you for taking the time to learn a little bit about me and my work! If you're interested in scheduling a session or would like to see more of my portfolio, let's get in touch. I can't wait to work together to bring your vision to life!
